text.aria-label: Title text 'Tail calibration of every arm'

Subtitle text 'Share of measured values at or below each tail quantile, on the five decision sites' scored rows. Orange tick: the nominal level; a dot on the tick is perfectly calibrated, a dot to its right means the quantile sits too low.'

rows. Orange tick: the nominal level; a dot on the tick is perfectly calibrated, a dot to its
right means the quantile sits too low.
